title: Tahini Paste
description: Tahini Paste is a smooth, rich sesame-based paste made from toasted sesame seeds and oil. It has a nutty, creamy flavor and is widely used as a base for hummus, tahini sauce, and drizzles over roasted vegetables or falafel.

ingredients.title: Ingredients (makes about 1 cup / 240 ml)
items: 1 cup hulled sesame seeds (lightly toasted for depth)
3–4 tbsp neutral oil (grapeseed, sunflower, or light olive oil)
1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice (optional, for slight tang)
1/4 tsp ground cumin (optional, for subtle warmth)

instruction.title: Method
steps:
1. Toast the sesame seeds:
• Heat a dry skillet over medium-low heat.
• Add the sesame seeds and stir constantly for 4–6 minutes until light golden and fragrant. Do not burn; it will turn bitter.
• Remove from heat and cool completely.

2. Grind the seeds:
• Place cooled sesame seeds in a food processor or high-speed blender.
• Blend for 1–2 minutes until a crumbly paste forms.

3. Emulsify with oil:
• Add 3 tablespoons of neutral oil and salt.
• Blend for 2–3 minutes until smooth.
• Check texture: for a silkier, pourable paste, add more oil or 1–2 tablespoons of cold water gradually.

4. Optional flavor lift:
• Add lemon juice and cumin if desired.
• Blend briefly to combine.

5. Texture check:
• High-end restaurants often prefer silky, slightly runny tahini, perfect for drizzling or blending into sauces. Adjust oil/water to achieve this.

6. Storage:
• Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
• Stir before each use; separation is natural.

servingSuggestions.title: This tahini can be used to make:
items: Hummus – blend with chickpeas, garlic, lemon, olive oil
Tahini sauce – mix with lemon, garlic, water, salt
Drizzles – over roasted vegetables or falafel

chefTips: Use hulled sesame seeds for smoother texture. Unhulled gives a nuttier, slightly bitter flavor.
Lightly toasting enhances aroma but avoid over-browning.
Cold water emulsification gives a creamy, luxurious mouthfeel.
For ultra-premium tahini, use neutral sunflower oil instead of olive oil to avoid bitterness.
